data.one_liner: A single-purpose Flutter widget for displaying a badge over icons or other elements.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FlutterBadge widget to render count badges on icons, images, or anywhere in the widget tree. Supports customization of badge colors, text colors, border radius, and positioning.
use_when: You need to show notification counts or markers on bottom navigation items or drawers
You want a simple badge overlay on icons without complex custom layout code
avoid_when: You need complex state management for badges across a large application architecture
You require non-numeric or rich content badges that go beyond basic item counts
strengths: Simple API with straightforward configuration options
Supports custom colors, text styles, and badge positions
weaknesses: Lacks advanced animation or transition options out of the box
